hotspots.title: Hungary’s EU migration pact protests
hotspots.blurb: Protests erupted in Budapest against Hungary's implementation of the EU migration pact, with thousands demanding the government reject it. Prime Minister Péter Magyar faced criticism for accepting the pact, allegedly in exchange for EU funds.
hotspots.affect: This issue commands attention due to its high moral charge and polarized contention, with accusations of betrayal and national sovereignty at stake.

hotspots.title: AfD’s extremism classification in Hesse
hotspots.blurb: The AfD continues to face scrutiny and potential extremism classification in Hesse, with ongoing debates about its influence on German politics and society. Recent polls show the AfD widening its lead over Chancellor Merz's bloc.
hotspots.affect: The classification debate fuels intense affective investment due to fears of far-right influence and democratic backsliding.

hotspots.title: Bullrich’s rebellion against Javier Milei
hotspots.blurb: Patricia Bullrich, Argentina's Security Minister, has openly defied President Javier Milei over judicial appointments and policy directions, causing internal rifts within the ruling La Libertad Avanza coalition.
hotspots.affect: The rebellion highlights deep internal divisions and power struggles, creating a sense of crisis within the government.

hotspots.title: Vannacci’s Futuro Nazionale gains momentum
hotspots.blurb: Roberto Vannacci's new political party, Futuro Nazionale, has gained significant traction, attracting multiple defectors from Lega and Forza Italia. The party's rise is reshaping Italy's right-wing political landscape.
hotspots.affect: The rapid rise of Vannacci's party generates intense affective investment due to its disruptive potential and far-right rhetoric.

hotspots.title: PP-Vox coalition deals in Spain
hotspots.blurb: Recent coalition agreements between PP and Vox in multiple Spanish regions have sparked controversy, particularly over policy concessions on immigration, LGBTQ+ rights, and historical memory.
hotspots.affect: The deals command attention due to their moral charge and the potential impact on social policies and human rights.
